biotools.summary: Thermo-Flux is a Python package that converts stoichiometric metabolic network models into comprehensive thermodynamic-stoichiometric models to improve flux predictions. It automates mass and charge balancing, handles transporter variants, and is designed to support metabolic research and biotechnological applications.
